subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Gateway/OpenResponses binary `input_file` receipt contract for Excel and allowlisted binaries, or narrow this issue to Excel while routing provider-native/generic document behavior elsewhere?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the remaining work defines public upload, storage, redaction, and tool-access semantics rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Approve narrow binary receipts
options.body: Keep this issue as the Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, and tool-access rules before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to Excel only
options.body: Limit this issue to allowlisted Excel persistence and leave generic/provider-native file forwarding to the broader file-input issue.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API design
options.body: Hold core behavior until a plugin or ClawHub package proves the workflow and any missing extension APIs are clear.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow binary receipts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, and tool-access rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest available history on OpenResponses input handling and was explicitly pulled into the issue discussion.
